task.title: Comments with pickers
task.body:
Answer a comment as easily as in a chat app, in Genbeya's format. See [[Experience#tasks]].

- [ ] A native text field above the keyboard (D4); `@`, `//` and `[[` pickers from the app
- [ ] Signed with the Git name and the local time with its offset, exactly as `task-comments.ts` writes it; headings in the text protected with `\`
- [ ] Edit and delete your own comments
- [ ] Conformance cases: append, edit, delete, a comment written on two branches
